source_request: 검은 원피스를 입고 소파에 앉은 하림

scene_delta.title: Elegant Evening Lounge
scene_delta.pose: Sitting gracefully on a plush velvet sofa, legs crossed at the ankles, leaning slightly back with one arm resting on the sofa cushion.
scene_delta.expression: Calm, subtle, enigmatic smile, eyes looking towards the camera with a soft gaze.
scene_delta.outfit: A sophisticated, form-fitting black midi-length cocktail dress with a subtle sweetheart neckline and long sleeves. The dress reaches mid-calf, paired with sheer black stockings and elegant black high-heeled pumps.
scene_delta.camera: Medium full shot, capturing her from the head down to the mid-calf, framing her sitting on the sofa.
scene_delta.lens: 50mm prime lens, shallow depth of field to softly blur the background.
scene_delta.lighting: Warm, ambient indoor lighting from a nearby floor lamp, creating soft highlights on her pale skin and hair.
scene_delta.location: A luxurious, modern living room with a dark velvet sofa and a minimalist background.
scene_delta.action: Relaxing on the sofa, posing for a portrait.
scene_delta.styling: Long straight dark hair styled neatly behind her shoulders, minimal jewelry including small silver earrings, natural makeup emphasizing her cat-like eyes.
scene_delta.negative_constraints: No other people, no exaggerated bust, no skeletal appearance, no visible rib protrusion, no messy hair, no bright/harsh lighting, no casual/sporty clothing, no bare lower body.
